entries.scope: Prisma7.8 exact mysql2=3.15.3; included in omitdev audit via optional Prisma peer
entries.reachability: App/src uses Supabase/PostgreSQL, no mysql2 import/call found. High requires actual MySQL connection to malicious/MITM server; moderate also needs compression enabled. No MySQL endpoint/credential/handshake used or tested.

Maintainer advisory page still says no patched version, so record discrepancy and use release commit evidence. Compression fix registry says3.23.1; verify maintainer patch before future update. Prisma exact pin means parent update needed, no overrides/downgrade6.19.3.
entries.required_tests: Supported parent release with synthetic MySQL plugin downgrade/compression limits tests, CLI compatibility and clean peers; no real service tests in R1C.
